title: Group working with electronics kits around a table
visual_facts: Several people sit around a light wood table, leaning over small components and printed instructions.
Open cardboard trays and clear plastic bags holding parts cover much of the table.
A large projection screen at the rear displays two instructional diagrams.
Benches and equipment are visible in the bright workshop behind the group.
spatial_relations: The people face inward toward the shared table and kits.
The projection screen is behind the group.
Boxes and bags of components are spread across the table between the people.
uncertainties: The small projected labels and components are not legible enough to identify specific parts.
